usedFor: Bitbucket code activity becomes a Google Sheets log, with “Add New Row to Sheet” adding a line per pull request.

bestTemplate.name: “Pull Request Merges” in Bitbucket, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each merged pull request lands as a row, giving you a running list of finished work.

watchOut: “Pipeline State Changed” in Bitbucket is polling, so a failed or passed pipeline can reach the sheet late.
